content: Hybrid search (BM25 + dense vectors via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k=60) reliably beats either alone on benchmarks (RRF NDCG 0.7068 vs BM25 0.6983 vs KNN 0.6953 on WANDS). RRF avoids score-scale mismatch between BM25 and cosine. Overhead is mainly implementation complexity, not runtime cost, at small scale.
